Leo · Listen & Shadow 22

Football Talk — your team, your position, why you go back
D O   E N G L I S H   W I T H   B R I A N
PART 1 · YOUR TEAM
👤 Friend
Who do you support?
어느 팀 응원해?
support — 응원하다
💬 Leo
I've supported the same team since high school.
고등학교 때부터 같은 팀 응원해왔어.
since ~ — ~부터 쭉
같은 패턴으로 — I've supported them since I was ten. · I've used the same keyboard since last year.
💬 Leo
I'd never switch — that's not really my thing.
절대 안 바꿔 — 바꾸는 건 좀 아닌 것 같아.
switch — 바꾸다 · not my thing — 나랑 안 맞는 것
같은 패턴으로 — I'd never switch phones mid-year. · Loud bars aren't really my thing.
👤 Friend
What's the best match you've ever watched?
제일 기억나는 경기는?
match — 경기
💬 Leo
The best one I've seen was decided in the last few minutes.
제가 본 최고 경기는 마지막 몇 분에 뒤집힌 경기였어.
decided — 승부가 갈린 · the last few minutes — 막판 몇 분
같은 패턴으로 — The best one I've seen was a penalty shootout. · The worst one was over by half-time.
💬 Leo
I'd rather watch it with people than alone.
혼자 보는 것보단 같이 보는 게 좋아.
I'd rather A than B — B보다 A가 낫다
같은 패턴으로 — I'd rather cook than order in. · I'd rather walk than take a taxi.
PART 2 · ON THE PITCH
👤 Friend
What position do you play?
넌 어디서 뛰어?
position — 포지션
💬 Leo
I usually play in midfield.
보통 미드필더를 봐.
midfield — 미드필드
같은 패턴으로 — I usually sit on the left. · I usually take the early shift.
💬 Leo
I'm decent at passing, but my finishing is another story.
패스는 괜찮은데 마무리가 좀 그래.
decent at ~ — ~는 괜찮은 · another story — 얘기가 다르다
같은 패턴으로 — I'm decent at cooking, but baking is another story. · He's decent at design, but the code is another story.
💬 Leo
I can shield the ball, but I don't have the pace.
공은 지킬 수 있는데, 스피드가 안 돼.
shield the ball — 몸으로 공을 지키다 · pace — 스피드
같은 패턴으로 — I can hold a conversation, but I don't have the vocabulary. · She can shield the ball all day.
💬 Leo
The worst one was when I missed with the goal wide open.
최악은 다 열어놓고 못 넣었을 때였어.
wide open — 텅 빈, 활짝 열린
같은 패턴으로 — The worst one was when I forgot my lines. · The worst part was when the screen froze.
PART 3 · WHY YOU GO BACK
👤 Friend
You've played for years. What keeps you going back?
몇 년째 하는데, 뭐가 계속 나가게 만들어?
keep ~ing — 계속 ~하다
💬 Leo
What keeps me going back is the people.
계속 나가게 되는 건 사람들 때문이야.
what keeps me ~ing is ~ — 계속 ~하게 만드는 건 ~다
같은 패턴으로 — What keeps me going is the deadline. · What keeps me coming back is the food.
💬 Leo
It gives me something the gym doesn't — winning and losing.
헬스장엔 없는 게 여기 있어 — 이기고 지는 것.
give someone something ~ doesn't — ~에는 없는 걸 주다
같은 패턴으로 — It gives me something work doesn't — silence. · Running gives me something the gym doesn't.
💬 Leo
I'd like to think I'll still be playing at fifty.
쉰 살에도 뛰고 있으면 좋겠어.
I'd like to think ~ — ~였으면 좋겠다
같은 패턴으로 — I'd like to think I'll still be coding at sixty. · I'd like to think it'll get easier.
💬 Leo
When I can't play, something's missing from the week.
못 뛰는 주엔 뭔가 허전해.
something's missing — 뭔가 빠진 느낌이다
같은 패턴으로 — When I skip breakfast, something's missing. · Without music, something's missing.
느리게 16/16 · 보통 16/16
